observations: Three photos show a black electronic keyboard with 61 keys, placed on artificial green grass.
The keyboard has a central control panel with multiple buttons, sliders, and a small display screen.
The keys appear to be in good condition with no visible cracks or missing keys.
The surface of the keyboard shows some minor scuffs and wear, especially on the edges and around the buttons.
The keyboard is powered on in all photos, as indicated by the illuminated buttons and display.
No power cord or accessories are visible in any photo.

claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children
claims.evidence: The keyboard appears to be in good physical condition, but there is no visual proof of its functionality or suitability for children. The seller's claim about 'quality' and 'good' cannot be verified from the photos alone.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the keyboard being powered on, keys being played, and sound output.

risks.risk: The keyboard may be missing essential accessories such as power adapter, stand, or sustain pedal.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the keyboard.

risks.risk: The keyboard may have hidden damage to the internal circuitry or speakers, which cannot be seen externally.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the speaker grilles and internal components, or a video of the sound output.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard being powered on and played to confirm functionality.
Photo showing all included accessories (power adapter, stand, etc.).
Close-up of the speaker grilles and internal components to check for damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
